## EMST role: Park ranger (visitor and resource management) (state variant, journey level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, confidence 0.6, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R21-park-ranger-visitor-resource/state:2641`). *Authority position (editorial):* resource-manager.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Provide visitor information, orientation and safety messaging in parks and protected areas — journey L2 *(distinguishing)*
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2
- Assess tree risk and structural condition — journey L2
- Plan and manage recreation opportunity and visitor use — journey L2
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — journey L2
- Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings — journey L2
- Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents — journey L2
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L1
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — journey L2
- Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land — journey L2
- Assess and design for scenic resources — journey L2
- Monitor and steward wilderness character — journey L2
- Construct and maintain trails to sustainable design standards — journey L2

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Orient visitors at a contact station to routes, conditions, regulations and hazards matched to their plans and abilities — 5.3% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Give safety information and trip recommendations tailored to current conditions and each visitor's stated plans — 4.7% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Log visitor questions, incidents and concerns to identify information gaps and revise visitor messaging — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Check visitor information from automated or online sources against current site conditions before it is posted or repeated to visitors — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Assign recreation opportunity classes to a planning area from setting characteristics, access and existing use — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Estimate visitor use and capacity for a site from counts, permits and indicators of resource and social conditions — 3.7%
- Assess an injured or ill person in a remote location with a structured patient assessment, giving first aid within the scope of training — 3.7%
- Coordinate a medical evacuation from a remote site, passing patient condition, location and landing or access information to responders — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Test field radios and satellite devices for a work area before deployment, programming channels and confirming coverage at key locations — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Set the communication plan for a field operation, including check-in times, frequencies, escalation steps and overdue-person procedures — 3.7%
- Verify remote-sensed or analytics-flagged tree risk scores on the ground, recording each override with the field reason — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Answer public questions about an uncertain environmental risk at a meeting or by phone using the current message map — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
